rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Grandiflora.
Exhibition name: La Parisienne ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Delbard (France, before 2009).
Introduced in France by Delbard/Georges Delbard SA in 2009 as 'La Parisienne'.
Introduced in United States by Certified Nurseries in 2018 as 'La Parisienne'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow blend. Yellow, petal edges turning orange and then pink as it ages. None to mild fragrance. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
